Profile diagram of a tropical rainforest showing three distinct vertical layers. The tallest trees with wide umbrella-shaped crowns stand alone at the top (Emergent layer). Below them is a solid block of green treetops (Canopy). Below that are thin, straight trunks with little foliage, and broad-leaved ferns on the dark forest floor (Undergrowth). Vines (lianas) hang from the branches, and wide, triangular buttress roots support the bases of the large trees.
